items.title: Classic Concentration
items.description: A revival of the original 1958 (and later 1973) show Concentration, Classic Concentration is an updated version on the classic game. Contestants compete against each other to remember the placement of prizes under numbered cards. As each card is taken away, a rebus puzzle is slowly revealed.

items.title: Concentration (1973)
items.description: In this reboot of the 1958 classic of the same name, contestants continue making matches on a board of 30 numbers to win prizes and make their way to the double play round  for the chance to win a new Chevy Chevette.
